items.name: Ring of Animal Influence
items.effect: Holds 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to befriend a beast, to frighten beasts before you, or to talk with animals for a while.

components.label: Heart of a great beast, or a primal emerald (rare+)

recipe.lore: Beasts defer to the heart of whatever ruled their forest; the raven's tongue gives the ring words and the lion's mane gives it teeth.

items.name: Ring of Djinni Summoning
items.effect: Speak its command word to call forth the djinni bound within, who serves you for up to an hour a day. If the djinni is ever slain the ring goes dead.

recipe.requires: The djinni-tempest-core must come from a djinni that was defeated or bound, not bargained with; the ring summons that same djinni.
recipe.lore: The tempest core is the djinni's own name in solid form; set beneath storm-glass it becomes a door the spirit must answer.

items.name: Ring of Elemental Command (Air)
items.effect: You can speak Auran, air elementals find it hard to strike you, falls barely hurt, and you can spend charges on winds, lightning and chains of storm. While worn it also lets you command a single bound elemental of its kind. Its 5 charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.requires: The crafter must defeat an elemental of the ring's element during the crafting month; its core is one of the two required.
recipe.lore: Air elemental cores spin inside the setting like trapped weather; the storm-glass tells them who is master.

items.name: Ring of Elemental Command (Earth)
items.effect: You can speak Terran, earth elementals falter against you, rubble and mud slow you not at all, and you can spend charges to shape stone, shake the ground or walk through rock. While worn it also lets you command a single bound elemental of its kind. Its 5 charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.requires: The crafter must defeat an elemental of the ring's element during the crafting month; its core is one of the two required.
recipe.lore: Xorn gut-stones have been through the world's belly and back; a worldheart diamond gives the band the weight of a mountain.

items.name: Ring of Elemental Command (Fire)
items.effect: You can speak Ignan, fire elementals struggle to harm you, you shrug off fire, and you can spend charges to hurl flame, raise walls of fire and call fire elementals. While worn it also lets you command a single bound elemental of its kind. Its 5 charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.requires: The crafter must defeat an elemental of the ring's element during the crafting month; its core is one of the two required.
recipe.lore: Brass cinders from an efreeti's city chain the flame, and the ruby is a window it can look out of but never escape.

items.name: Ring of Elemental Command (Water)
items.effect: You can speak Aquan, water elementals have trouble striking you, you swim and breathe underwater, and you can spend charges to part seas, freeze waves and summon water elementals. While worn it also lets you command a single bound elemental of its kind. Its 5 charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.requires: The crafter must defeat an elemental of the ring's element during the crafting month; its core is one of the two required.
recipe.lore: Pearls grow around irritation in the sea; the tideheart grew around a storm, and it keeps the ring's waters obedient.

items.name: Ring of Evasion
items.effect: Holds 3 charges, regained at dawn. When you fail a Dexterity save you can spend a charge as a reaction to succeed instead.

components.label: Slippery, elusive keystone (astral silver thread, marilith hand, oni essence or young copper dragon essence)

recipe.lore: Blink dog teeth are never quite where you bit them; wound with astral thread they teach the wearer the same half-step aside. An oni's essence, which knows how to turn to mist, or a young copper dragon's, a born dodger, also teach the ring to slip aside.

items.name: Ring of Feather Falling
items.effect: Whenever you fall, you drift down gently at a leisurely pace and land without harm.

components.label: Something that refuses to fall (rare flight)

recipe.lore: Wind-seeds and feather-fern are packed under the setting so the ring always has a little breeze to lean on; the keystone remembers the sky.

items.name: Ring of Free Action
items.effect: Difficult terrain costs you nothing extra, and magic can neither slow you nor leave you paralyzed or restrained.

components.label: Slick aboleth mucus or spell-shedding nullthorn (rare)

recipe.lore: Nothing gets a grip on aboleth slime; sealed under quicksilver it keeps every snare, glue and spell sliding off the wearer.

items.name: Ring of Invisibility
items.effect: Turn invisible at will, along with everything you wear and carry, until you attack, cast a spell or choose to reappear.

components.label: Gloom-gland of an ancient black dragon or kraken ink

recipe.lore: A stalker's core is clear as breath and a cube's gel swallows light; bound with shadowsilk around the gloom-gland, the wearer simply stops being noticed by the world.

items.name: Ring of Jumping
items.effect: Lets you cast jump on yourself at will as a bonus action.

recipe.lore: Frog legs and goat hooves give the spring; the floating keystone makes sure you do not come down too soon.

items.name: Ring of Mind Shielding
items.effect: Your thoughts, lies and nature are hidden from magic that would read them, and telepathy only reaches you if you allow it. When you die your soul may shelter in the ring.

recipe.lore: A doppelganger's brain spends its life hiding what it truly is; lined with lead, which no prying sense can see through, the ring keeps your mind just as closed.

items.name: Ring of Protection
items.effect: Grants a +1 bonus to AC and to all saving throws.

recipe.lore: Old smiths say jade 'drinks the blow'; set around a guardian's scale or a warded diamond, it spreads that drinking over the whole body.

items.name: Ring of Regeneration
items.effect: While you have at least 1 hit point you steadily recover hit points every 10 minutes, and lost limbs or organs slowly grow back.

recipe.lore: A troll heart kept in a jar keeps beating; crushed into the setting with everbloom root, it lends that stubbornness to whoever wears the ring.

items.name: Ring of Resistance (Acid)
items.effect: You have resistance to acid damage while you wear it.

recipe.lore: Pearls are the one treasure a black dragon's swamp cannot dissolve.

items.name: Ring of Resistance (Cold)
items.effect: You have resistance to cold damage while you wear it.

recipe.lore: Frost lichen thrives where nothing else can, and rime crystal turns the chill aside like water off glass.

items.name: Ring of Resistance (Fire)
items.effect: You have resistance to fire damage while you wear it.

recipe.lore: What was born in flame does not fear it; emberbloom petals under a garnet teach the wearer's skin the same indifference.

items.name: Ring of Resistance (Force)
items.effect: You have resistance to force damage while you wear it.

recipe.lore: Star-iron survived falling through the sky; its stubbornness, set beneath sapphire, turns raw magical force aside.

items.name: Ring of Resistance (Lightning)
items.effect: You have resistance to lightning damage while you wear it.

recipe.lore: Fulgurite is lightning's footprint in sand; bound with a storm-born scale it gives the bolt somewhere else to go.

items.name: Ring of Resistance (Necrotic)
items.effect: You have resistance to necrotic damage while you wear it.

recipe.lore: Jet has been mourning stone since before memory; paired with a scale or pearl that has already tasted death, it keeps death's touch shallow.

items.name: Ring of Resistance (Poison)
items.effect: You have resistance to poison damage while you wear it.

recipe.lore: Amethyst has always been the drinker's charm against being overcome; wyrmbane thistle makes it work against venom too.

items.name: Ring of Resistance (Psychic)
items.effect: You have resistance to psychic damage while you wear it.

recipe.lore: A thought crystal already carries a mind's pressure; set in calming jade it bleeds off any assault on the wearer's thoughts.

items.name: Ring of Resistance (Radiant)
items.effect: You have resistance to radiant damage while you wear it.

recipe.lore: Sun-amber has held a sunbeam for an age without burning; it teaches the wearer to hold holy light the same way.

items.name: Ring of Resistance (Thunder)
items.effect: You have resistance to thunder damage while you wear it.

components.label: Thunder-proof keystone (rare+): djinni core, thunderhead shard, androsphinx larynx or young blue dragon essence

recipe.lore: Hushmoss swallows sound; wrapped around a storm-heart and a ringing crystal, it drinks the shockwave before it reaches bone. A young blue dragon's storm-steeped essence serves the same purpose.

items.name: Ring of Shooting Stars
items.effect: Works only outdoors at night. Conjure dancing lights or light at will, and spend charges on faerie fire, crackling orbs of lightning, or a hail of tiny burning stars. Its 6 charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.requires: The final setting must be done under a clear night sky.
recipe.lore: Meteoric iron already fell from the sky once; a will-o'-wisp's lantern and a star sapphire teach it to call its siblings down.

items.name: Ring of Spell Storing
items.effect: Holds up to 5 levels' worth of spells cast into it by anyone. The wearer can release any stored spell as if they had cast it.

recipe.lore: A shield guardian's spell cavity was grown to hold one spell for its master; cut down and set in gold, it holds several for you.

items.name: Ring of Spell Turning
items.effect: You have advantage on saves against spells that target only you, and on a natural high roll you can bounce a single-target spell back at its caster.

recipe.lore: The tarrasque's shell throws spells back at the fool who cast them; a sliver polished behind quicksilver, like the back of a mirror, still does.

items.name: Ring of Swimming
items.effect: Grants a swimming speed of 40 feet.

recipe.lore: Sailors wear aquamarine against drowning; a sea-horse fin and a twist of kelp teach the hand to push water like a fish's tail.

items.name: Ring of Telekinesis
items.effect: Lets you cast telekinesis at will, but only on objects nobody is wearing or carrying.

recipe.lore: A bronze dragon's repulsion gland shoves without touching; paired with lodestone, which pulls iron, and an ioun shard that floats of its own will, it teaches the mind to push and pull at a distance.

items.name: Ring of the Ram
items.effect: Holds 3 charges. Spend one or more to hurl a spectral ram's head at a creature, dealing force damage and shoving it away, or to smash an object open. It regains 1d3 charges each dawn.

recipe.lore: Three horns from three chargers, ground and fused; the bronze dragon's repulsion gland supplies the shove that sends the ram's ghost flying.

items.name: Ring of Three Wishes
items.effect: Holds 3 charges; each lets you cast wish. Once the last charge is spent the ring is only a trinket.

recipe.requires: A wish must be cast into the ring on the final day; the beads are consumed as the charges are spent.
recipe.lore: Three wishglass beads, one for each wish, strung around the only flower that grants them; crafters say every clover in the band is one bad outcome averted.

items.name: Ring of Warmth
items.effect: You resist cold damage, and you and your gear stay comfortable in bitter cold far below freezing.

recipe.lore: A cinder that never goes out, cradled in garnet: arctic traders swear the ring is warmer than their own blood.

items.name: Ring of Water Walking
items.effect: Lets you stand on and walk across any liquid as though it were solid ground.

recipe.lore: Ambergris and shark oil float on any sea; a sliver of driftwood reminds the ring that the water is a floor, not a door.

items.name: Ring of X-ray Vision
items.effect: Speak a command word to see through solid matter within 30 feet for a minute; thin lead or thicker stone and metal still block it. Using it again the same day can exhaust you.

recipe.lore: A xorn sees gems through solid rock; its gut-stones behind stalker clearglass lend that sight to the wearer - but never through lead, which it cannot eat.

items.name: Rod of Absorption
items.effect: As a reaction, soak up a spell aimed only at you, storing its levels in the rod. You can later spend stored levels to fuel your own spells, up to a lifetime limit.

recipe.lore: Spells slide off a rakshasa's hide and vanish; wrapped around an adamantine core with an arcane crystal at the tip, the rod catches them instead.

items.name: Rod of Alertness
items.effect: Keeps you sharp: advantage on Perception and initiative, and it can detect hidden foes and magic. Once a day, plant it to shed light and ward allies nearby with a small bonus to AC.

recipe.lore: An ettin always keeps one head awake; its eye set at the rod's crown beside an angel's never-closing gaze means the bearer is never truly caught napping.

items.name: Immovable Rod
items.effect: Press its button and the rod locks in place, defying gravity and holding up to several tons until pushed with tremendous force. Press again to release it.

recipe.lore: An earth elemental core wants nothing more than to stay put; the button just tells it when.

items.name: Rod of Lordly Might
items.effect: A +3 mace whose studs transform it into a flaming blade, a battleaxe, a spear, a climbing pole, a battering ram or a compass. Once a day each, it can drain a foe's life, paralyze a creature or terrify everyone nearby.

recipe.lore: Forge-iron from a fire giant's hammer for the head, kobold spring-work for the studs, and at its heart the dread of something that ruled a mountain.

items.name: Rod of Rulership
items.effect: Once a day, hold it aloft to command the obedience of creatures of your choice within sight, charming them for up to 8 hours unless they resist.

recipe.lore: An aboleth made slaves of whole cities with its mind; a sliver of that will, dressed in gold and a noble's signet, makes people want to kneel.

items.name: Rod of Resurrection
items.attune: by a cleric, druid, or paladin
items.effect: Holds 5 charges. Spend them to cast heal or even to return the dead to life; if the last charge is spent, the rod may crumble. It regains 1 charge each dawn.

components.label: Tears or lifesap of the heavens (legendary)

recipe.lore: A solar weeps only for the worthy dead, and its tears remember how to call them back; the unicorn horn keeps the returning soul untainted.

items.name: Rod of Security
items.effect: Carry up to 199 willing creatures into a pocket paradise where they need no food, heal quickly and do not age, for a total of up to 200 days split among them.

recipe.lore: The golden bough grows only in gardens where no one is ever hungry; the rod carries a seed of that garden, and manna keeps it fed.

items.name: Staff of Charming
items.attune: by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
items.effect: Holds 10 charges for charm person, command or comprehend languages. Once a day it can turn a charm spell you resisted back on its caster. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

components.label: Beguiling keystone (rare+): mirage lotus, vampire essence, glabrezu tongue or young green dragon essence

recipe.lore: Feywood and a harpy's voice-box sing softly in the grain; a mirage lotus at the crown makes whatever you say sound like the best idea anyone ever had. A glabrezu's honeyed tongue or a young green dragon's persuasive essence charms as reliably as the lotus.

items.name: Staff of Fire
items.attune: by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
items.effect: Grants fire resistance and holds 10 charges for burning hands, fireball or wall of fire. Spend the last charge and it may burn to ash. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: The staff is quenched in fire-giant forge ash so it will not char, then sheathed in salamander scales; the living ember at its heart does the rest.

items.name: Staff of Frost
items.attune: by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
items.effect: Grants cold resistance and holds 10 charges for fog cloud, ice storm, wall of ice or cone of cold. Spend the last charge and it may melt away. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: Carved from wood left to freeze for a winter, capped with ice that has never once melted; a winter wolf's frost gland gives the staff its breath.

items.name: Staff of Healing
items.attune: by a bard, cleric, or druid
items.effect: Holds 10 charges for cure wounds, lesser restoration or mass cure wounds, cast with your own spellcasting ability. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: A unicorn's horn cures any poison it touches; bound into rowan with healer's moss and bloodstone, it lends that mercy to every tap of the staff.

items.name: Staff of Power
items.attune: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
items.effect: A +2 quarterstaff that also boosts your AC, saving throws and spell attacks. Its 20 charges fuel a battery of spells from magic missile to wall of force, and it can be broken in a devastating final blast. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: An archmage's notes are inked down the shaft in sublime ink, star-iron shods its foot, and the star sapphire at its head stores the power they describe.

items.name: Staff of Striking
items.effect: A +3 quarterstaff with 10 charges; on a hit you can spend up to 3 charges to add a burst of force damage. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: Ironwood capped with adamantine takes any blow; soaked in a storm giant's blood, it gives them back harder.

items.name: Staff of Swarming Insects
items.attune: by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
items.effect: Holds 10 charges for giant insect or insect plague, and can wrap you in a buzzing cloud that hides you from sight. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: A hollowed staff lined with wasp-paper becomes a hive; chitin dust and wings call the swarm, and a primal heart tells it whom to obey.

items.name: Staff of the Magi
items.attune: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
items.effect: A +2 quarterstaff that sharpens your spell attacks, drinks spells cast at you to recharge itself, and holds 50 charges for a vast list of spells. Breaking it unleashes a cataclysmic blast. Spent charges also return in part each dawn.

recipe.requires: Traditionally the crafter must be an archmage in their own right, with a spellbook of at least 7th-level spells.
recipe.lore: Rakshasa hide lets it swallow spells, the star sapphire hoards them, and whatever keystone sits at its core has outlived the magic of entire ages.

items.name: Staff of the Python
items.attune: by a cleric, druid, or warlock
items.effect: Throw it down and it becomes a giant constrictor snake under your command until you call it back. If the snake is killed, the staff is destroyed.

recipe.lore: The staff is wrapped in a constrictor's shed skin and cords of its coil muscle; doppelganger blood reminds the wood that it can become what it wears.

items.name: Staff of the Woodlands
items.effect: A +2 quarterstaff that boosts spell attacks, with charges for nature spells such as barkskin, awaken and wall of thorns. It can also be planted to grow into a great tree and later return. It holds 10 charges, which return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: Carve from the heartwood of a willing treant and it never stops being a tree; dryad wood and mistletoe keep it on speaking terms with the forest.

items.name: Staff of Thunder and Lightning
items.effect: A +2 quarterstaff that can, once a day each, add lightning or thunder to a hit, loose a lightning bolt, clap a deafening boom, or unleash both at once.

recipe.lore: Wood from a tree struck twice gives the lightning its path, and a resonant crystal gives the thunder its voice; the thunderhead shard is the storm itself.

items.name: Staff of Withering
items.attune: by a cleric, druid, or warlock
items.effect: Holds 3 charges. On a hit you can spend one to add necrotic damage and leave the target's body aching and weakened for an hour. It regains 1d3 charges each dawn.

recipe.lore: Gloomwood soaked in mourning salt draws the life out of what it touches; black lotus in the grain makes sure the wound never feels quite healed.

items.name: Wand of Binding
items.effect: Holds 7 charges for hold monster or hold person, and can spend a charge to help you slip free of grapples or resist being paralyzed. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: A link of a chain devil's chain is filed thin and coiled around the wand; roper strand and mimic glue ensure whatever it points at stays put.

items.name: Wand of Enemy Detection
items.effect: Holds 7 charges, which return in part each dawn. Spend one to sense, for a minute, the direction of the nearest creature within 60 feet that is hostile to you, even through invisibility or illusion.

recipe.lore: An erinyes hunts oath-breakers across planes; her eye in the wand's tip swivels toward anyone who wishes you harm.

items.name: Wand of Fear
items.effect: Holds 7 charges: command a creature to flee, or blast a cone of terror that sends those who fail to resist running. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: A cloaker's moan makes grown warriors weep; its sac, dried in dread nettle, gives the wand a whisper nobody wants to hear twice.

items.name: Wand of Fireballs
items.effect: Holds 7 charges to cast fireball, with more charges for a hotter blast. Draining it fully may destroy it. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: Sulfur and saltpeter for the bang, a chimera's fire gland for the spark, and a dragon's breath gland to throw it all at your enemies.

items.name: Wand of Lightning Bolts
items.effect: Holds 7 charges to cast lightning bolt, with extra charges for a more powerful strike. Draining it fully may destroy it. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: The blank is replaced by a sliver of lightning-struck wood, wound with copper so the behir's charge knows which way to run.

items.name: Wand of Magic Detection
items.effect: Holds 3 charges; spend one to cast detect magic. It regains 1d3 charges each dawn.

recipe.lore: A chuul's antennae twitch toward enchantment the way a hound's nose finds blood; mounted on a wand they still do.

items.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
items.effect: Holds 7 charges to cast magic missile, adding a dart for each extra charge spent. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: The first spell every apprentice learns, captured in residue scraped from a wizard's workbench; the quartz tip splits it into darts.

items.name: Wand of Paralysis
items.effect: Holds 7 charges. Spend one to fire a pale ray that can leave a creature paralyzed for a minute unless it shakes off the effect. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: Ghoul claws and chuul tentacles numb the flesh they touch; the silver dragon's gland lets that numbness leap across a room.

items.name: Wand of Polymorph
items.effect: Holds 7 charges; spend one to cast polymorph. Draining it fully may destroy it. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: Doppelganger skin forgets what it looked like; a rakshasa never had one true shape. Between them, the wand makes flesh just as forgetful.

items.name: Wand of Secrets
items.effect: Holds 3 charges; spend one and it twitches toward the nearest secret door or trap nearby. It regains 1d3 charges each dawn.

recipe.lore: A xorn can taste hollow spaces in solid rock; tie its essence to a thief's picks and the wand points to every hidden seam.

items.name: Wand of the War Mage +1
items.effect: Grants a +1 bonus to your spell attack rolls and lets your spell attacks ignore half cover.

recipe.lore: The hawk's eye never misses a mouse; a little of its focus in the wand keeps your spells on target.

items.name: Wand of the War Mage +2
items.effect: Grants a +2 bonus to your spell attack rolls and lets your spell attacks ignore half cover.

recipe.lore: Battle-mages set a giant eagle's eye in the pommel so the wand looks around cover for them.

items.name: Wand of the War Mage +3
items.effect: Grants a +3 bonus to your spell attack rolls and lets your spell attacks ignore half cover.

recipe.lore: Only a star sapphire holds enough focus for the finest war wands; the eagle's eye beside it seems to see the target before you do.

items.name: Wand of Web
items.effect: Holds 7 charges; spend one to cast web. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

components.label: Drider silk gland or phase spider silk (uncommon)

recipe.lore: The wand is wound like a spindle with giant spider silk; the drider's gland keeps it producing more whenever you flick your wrist.

items.name: Wand of Wonder
items.effect: Holds 7 charges. Each use produces a random magical effect, from a hail of butterflies to a fireball or turning the target into something else entirely. Spent charges return in part each dawn.

recipe.lore: Fey pollen, a lucky clover and the eye of something that never stops gibbering: no two crafters agree on the recipe, which crafters say is rather the point.
